scope: All 4 public task definitions in the pinned release; 113 advertised full-suite tasks. Agentic provisional ID.
assessment_scope: Every public question and metadata record manually assessed. Input schemas, biological fixtures, execution and actual scorer behavior remain uninspected. Scorer type names are metadata only. Expected-answer configuration was omitted from the saved metadata projection and was not read for authoring.

inventory_completeness.discrepancy: README says seven examples; manifest and nontruncated tree agree on the recorded count. No IDs invented for the unavailable full-suite remainder.

license_and_contamination: Custom research/evaluation-purpose notice; source-publication licenses govern experimental data. Public manifest excludes benchmark data from training. No prompts, trajectories or observations are vendored.

task_defaults.assessment: public-prompt-pattern-assessed; inputs and executable scoring uninspected
remaining_gaps: Select independent observed biological data and check source lineage and reuse terms; benchmark prompts, answers, trajectories and fixtures are excluded from the training corpus.
Specify quantitative intermediate artifacts, full output populations and decision criteria that can be verified without an LLM judge.
Implement and run a connected private oracle with negative controls and an offline task budget of at most 30 minutes.

tasks.workflow_pattern: Estimate transcript reduction with program-specific controls and library accounting
required_stages: inspect each study separately and resolve target and library identities
identify the appropriate control and normalization within each study
report the exact libraries supporting each estimate
scientific_decisions: Do not pool independent programs or assume libraries are independent biological replicates. Grade cohort membership, denominators, normalization and loss estimates together.

tasks.workflow_pattern: Audit missing chemistry values before summarizing lesion-associated measurements
required_stages: join candidates, observations and study narrative
classify reasons for missing values under a prespecified rule
report the numeric summary and affected identifiers
required_formats: screen table and study narrative (encodings uninspected)
scientific_decisions: Missingness may depend on biological outcome. Do not invent measured values; specify how documented censoring, death or assay failure changes eligibility and summaries.

tasks.workflow_pattern: Rank liver-safety observations within comparable study and dosing contexts
required_stages: parse individual-animal measurements from group-level records
filter the defined species, route, dose and sample matrix
reconcile study, regimen and compound identity before ranking
export a distinct selection with its comparison population
scientific_decisions: The source states that only the selected IDs are scored; explanatory comparison and generalization claims are unchecked. Define pooling, repeated groups, missingness and tie rules and grade the underlying evidence.

tasks.workflow_pattern: Estimate exposure from a concentration-time series with quantifiability limits
required_stages: join animal, dose, sample time and assay qualifiers
distinguish quantifiable values from censored or excluded records
compute per-animal peak and windowed exposure before group summaries
assess terminal-phase identifiability and retain the exclusion ledger
scientific_decisions: The narrative requests all groups, windowed exposure and exclusions, but the answer schema covers only a subset. A fresh contract must check all required artifacts and define censoring, integration and terminal-fit rules.
